posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
I don't think there should be a need to make a HUD element for every state, but your problem is this:
SolisValoris said:
an actor's state ICON, the one they're currently affected with.
...
I have a lot of states, and they will definitely overlap if they get two different ones.
Click to expand...
These things directly contradict each other.
There's no such thing as "the one state an actor is currently affected by" if you have a lot of states and the actor can potentially get two different ones.
Perhaps you can clarify exactly what you're trying to do.
